name: @rixmerz/flowtrace-browser
description: FlowTrace v2 browser capture: HTTP, navigation and error spans shipped to the dashboard collector
//: Published standalone, unlike every other capture layer. Those are vendored into @rixmerz/flowtrace because the CLI launches the runtime and injects them. A browser layer is a build-time dependency of the user’s own bundle, which no global CLI install can inject — and reaching it through the CLI tarball would cost a frontend 31MB of @swc/core and a 2.3MB Java jar for 60KB of code.
author: Juan Pablo Diaz <jpablo@rixmerz.dev>
